evidence.quote: that is the whole reason for the gate

observations.why: Quinton frames the gate as a direct response to a prior failure, carrying urgency and alarm about recurrence — high arousal, negative valence.
The summary is delivered in a settled, matter-of-fact register — low arousal, mildly positive valence of resolution and control.

mints.name: FailureDrivenGateUrgency
mints.title: that is the whole reason for the gate
mints.theme: Affect enters as urgency to prevent a named past failure from recurring, not as the speaker's own stake
